arxiv-2103-14472.title: Comment on ”High-Energy Symmetry of String Theory”
arxiv-2103-14472.creator: Sheng-Hong Lai, Jen-Chi Lee, Yi Yang
arxiv-2103-14472.description: Abstract Following the recent discovery of the Lauricella string scattering amplitudes (LSSA) and their associated exact S ​ L ​ ( K + 3 , C ) SL(K+3,C) symmetry, we give a brief comment on Gross conjecture regarding ”High-energy symmetry of string theory”.

arxiv-2108-06623.title: Spatially Modulated Superfluid State in Two-dimensional 4 He Films
arxiv-2108-06623.creator: Jaewon Choi, Alexey A. Zadorozhko, Jeakyung Choi, Eunseong Kim
arxiv-2108-06623.description: Abstract The second layer of 4 He films adsorbed on a graphite substrate is an excellent experimental platform to study the interplay between superfluid and structural orders. Here, we report a rigid two-frequency torsional oscillator study on the second layer as a function of temperature and 4 He atomic density.

arxiv-2112-03575.title: MESA: Offline Meta-RL for Safe Adaptation and Fault Tolerance
arxiv-2112-03575.creator: Michael Luo, Ashwin Balakrishna, Brijen Thananjeyan, Suraj Nair
arxiv-2112-03575.description: Abstract Safe exploration is critical for using reinforcement learning (RL) in risk-sensitive environments. Recent work learns risk measures which measure the probability of violating constraints, which can then be used to enable safety. However, learning such risk measures requires significant interaction with the environment, resulting in excessive constraint violations during learning.

arxiv-2305-02332.title: Large Cycles in Graphs Around Conjectures of Bondy and Jung - Modifications and Sharpness
arxiv-2305-02332.creator: Zhora Nikoghosyan
arxiv-2305-02332.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Zhora Nikoghosyan. A number of new sufficient conditions for generalized cycles (large cycles including Hamilton and dominating cycles as special cases) in an arbitrary k k -connected graph ( k = 1 , 2 , … ) (k=1,2,...) and new lower bounds for the circumference (the length of a longest cycle) are derived, inspiring a number of modifications of famous conjectures of Bondy (1980) and Jung (2001).

arxiv-2305-17558.title: Provably Fast Finite Particle Variants of SVGD via Virtual Particle Stochastic Approximation
arxiv-2305-17558.creator: Aniket Das, Dheeraj Nagaraj
arxiv-2305-17558.description: Abstract Stein Variational Gradient Descent (SVGD) is a popular variational inference algorithm which simulates an interacting particle system to approximately sample from a target distribution, with impressive empirical performance across various domains. Theoretically, its population (i.e, infinite-particle) limit dynamics is well studied but the behavior of SVGD in the finite-particle regime is much less understood.

arxiv-2306-03488.title: Correlated Pseudorandomness from the Hardness of Quasi-Abelian Decoding
arxiv-2306-03488.creator: Maxime Bombar and Geoffroy Couteau and Alain Couvreur and Clément Ducros
arxiv-2306-03488.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Maxime Bombar and Geoffroy Couteau and Alain Couvreur and Clément Ducros. Secure computation often benefits from the use of correlated randomness to achieve fast, non-cryptographic online protocols. A recent paradigm put forth by Boyle et al. (CCS 2018, Crypto 2019) showed how pseudorandom correlation generators ( PCG ) can be used to generate large amounts of useful forms of correlated (pseudo)randomness, using minimal interactions followed solely by local computations, yielding silent secure two-party computation protocols (protocols where the preprocessing phase requires almost no communication).

arxiv-2308-00502.title: The Jones polynomial for a torus knot with twists
arxiv-2308-00502.creator: Brandon Bavier, Brandy Doleshal
arxiv-2308-00502.description: Abstract . We compute the Jones polynomial for a three-parameter family of links, the twisted torus links of the form T ⁡ ( ( p , q ) , ( 2 , s ) ) T((p,q),(2,s)) where p p and q q are coprime and s s is nonzero.

arxiv-2404-19334.title: Multi-Scale Heterogeneity-Aware Hypergraph Representation for Histopathology Whole Slide Images Thanks: *Corresponding author. This project was funded by the National Natural Science Foundation of China 82090052.
arxiv-2404-19334.creator: Minghao Han 1 , Xukun Zhang 1 , Dingkang Yang 1 , Tao Liu 1 , Haopeng Kuang 1 , Jinghui Feng 1 , Lihua Zhang 1,2,3,4,∗
arxiv-2404-19334.description: Abstract Survival prediction is a complex ordinal regression task that aims to predict the survival coefficient ranking among a cohort of patients, typically achieved by analyzing patients’ whole slide images. Existing deep learning approaches mainly adopt multiple instance learning or graph neural networks under weak supervision.

arxiv-2409-10152.title: Characterization of Square Values and Power Sums of Consecutive Lucas Numbers
arxiv-2409-10152.creator: Priyabrata Mandal
arxiv-2409-10152.description: Abstract We establish several Diophantine results involving Lucas and Fibonacci numbers. First, we prove that L n = 3 ​ x 2 L_{n}=3x^{2} has the unique positive integer solution ( n , x ) = ( 2 , 1 ) (n,x)=(2,1) .

arxiv-2410-13560.title: Nash Equilibria of Rock Paper Scissors Variants
arxiv-2410-13560.creator: Adrian Thananopavarn
arxiv-2410-13560.description: Abstract We generalize Rock Paper Scissors to complete directed graphs, or tournaments, on n n vertices. Properties of the mixed-strategy Nash equilibria of these tournaments are discussed, particularly those with Nash equilibria where all of the strategies have a nonzero probability. We find graph-theoretic properties of such games and tabulate them for n ≤ 7 n\leq 7 .

arxiv-2411-00389.title: From scale-free to Anderson localization: a size-dependent transition
arxiv-2411-00389.creator: Burcu Yılmaz, Cem Yuce, Ceyhun Bulutay
arxiv-2411-00389.description: Abstract Scale-free localization in non-Hermitian systems is a distinctive type of localization where the localization length of certain eigenstates, known as scale-free localized (SFL) states, scales proportionally with the system size. Unlike skin states, where the localization length is independent of the system size, SFL states maintain a spatial profile that remains invariant as the system size changes.

arxiv-2412-20344.title: A Slowly Flattening Milky Way Stellar Disk: Investigating Galactic Warping through Dynamical Orbital Inclinations of Open Clusters
arxiv-2412-20344.creator: Liming Peng, Zhihong He ,
arxiv-2412-20344.description: Abstract By evaluating angular momentum directions of open cluster (OC) samples across various Galactocentric radii, we assessed their orbital plane inclinations. Our findings reveal that, without considering the local tilt of the Galactic disk near the sun, our results are consistent with previous studies on Classical Cepheids (CCs). Notably, the warp precession derived from OCs closely mirror those of CCs.

pmc-11328356.description: BackgroundTo investigate the peripapillary retinal nerve fibre layer (RNFL) thickness changes and analyse factors associated with visual recovery of G11778A Leber hereditary optic neuropathy (LHON) patients.MethodsPatients diagnosed with G11778A LHON between July 2017 and December 2020 in Tongji hospital were included in this follow-up study. Patients were grouped according to disease duration.

pmc-11653094.title: Challenges of MS‐based small extracellular vesicles proteomics
pmc-11653094.creator: Daniel Fochtman, Lukasz Marczak, Monika Pietrowska, Anna Wojakowska
pmc-11653094.description: Proteomic profiling of small extracellular vesicles (sEV) is a powerful tool for discovering biomarkers of various diseases. This process most often assisted by mass spectrometry (MS) usually lacks standardization and recognition of challenges which may lead to unreliable results. General recommendations for sEV MS analyses have been briefly given in the MISEV2023 guidelines.

pmc-11709353.title: Subcortical correlates of sleep across Alzheimer’s Disease and cognitively healthy adults: an in vivo study
pmc-11709353.creator: Neus Falgàs Martínez, Andrea Val‐Guardiola, Gerard Mayà, Marta Peña, Guadalupe Fernandez‐Villullas, Beatriz Bosch‐Capdevila, Albert Lladó, Emma Muñoz‐Moreno, Álex Iranzo, Lea T. Grinberg, Raquel Sanchez‐Valle
pmc-11709353.description: BackgroundNeuromodulatory subcortical systems (NSS) are affected from the early stages of Alzheimer’s Disease (AD) by the accumulation of tau pathology. Increased tau burden within the subcortical nucleus that are in control of sleep and wake regulation may contribute to the breakdown of sleep‐wake patterns in AD.

pmc-11716326.title: From Plan To Impact – expediting progress towards targets of the WHO Global Action Plan on Dementia
pmc-11716326.creator: Paola Barbarino, Diego Aguilar, Lewis Arthurton, Chris Lynch
pmc-11716326.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundIn 2017, all 194 Member States of the World Health Organization (WHO) unanimously adopted the Global Action Plan on the public health response to dementia 2017‐2025, the primary aim being for countries to implement National Dementia Plans (NDP). However, as outlined in Alzheimer’s Disease International’s (ADI) recent From Plan to Impact report, WHO Member States have been far too slow to act ‐ falling far short of the 146 countries target.

pmc-13556124.creator: Stefan Weber, Berthold Stöger, Maren Podewitz
pmc-13556124.description: Seesaw ligands enforce a coordination geometry of the two coligands being in a cis configuration in an octahedral environment.
